purpose: BH4 guard red-rule evidence: tests/incremental_state_transitions_adversarial.py is GREEN on the real Nift binary and RED on representative defects (a tool that drops a page, leaves a stale/orphan output, or produces nothing).
attack: Prior incremental guards (checkpoint-7, pagination) exercised content/add/template/metadata changes; removals/renames were only covered randomly. BH4 makes the state-transition sequence deterministic and asserts the exact output set (no stale, no missing) plus incremental==clean equivalence across modified/hash/hybrid modes, using nift rm/mv/track commands.
